answer: Reputation-weighted task auctions. Each identity starts at the lagoon tier, where only low-value jobs are visible; climbing toward the umber and summit tiers unlocks richer work but requires a track record of completed contracts. Since income scales with verified history, a sybil farm must fund and operate many identities through months of real, unpaid-at-first labor before any of them earns enough to repay its upkeep. Attacker cost is the ongoing labor and capital tied up per fake identity, with no shortcut purchase.
